title: add rag agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts + docs site updates
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Summary: Add a set of RAG agent templates, tool-calling example quickstarts (Python/TypeScript/Playground), and accompanying docs site updates to surface the new content. Motivation: provide clear, runnable examples for customers who want to compose retrieval-augmented generation workflows with agents and tool calling. This PR bundles templates, sample prompts, a small e2e example using the Python SDK, and navigation updates to the docs site so the quickstarts are discoverable from the main 'Guides' flow.

What this contains: (1) docs/rag/templates: four opinionated RAG agent templates (faq-bot, research-assistant, customer-support, code-explorer) with config examples and recommended prompt engineering notes; (2) redwood-examples/agents/tool-calling: Python and TypeScript quickstarts that wire up a small search index, a retrieval step, and a tool-calling handler; (3) redwood-examples/playground: a ready-to-run Docker/Playground example for demonstration; (4) docs site changes: navigation, quickstart landing page, example walk-throughs, and a short troubleshooting guide for common tokenization/kv-cache issues.

Checklist:
- [x] Add RAG agent templates and prompt guidance
- [x] Add Python quickstart with reproducible steps and requirements.txt
- [x] Add TypeScript quickstart and sample TS client
- [x] Add Playground/Docker example for demo teams
- [x] Docs site nav and quickstart pages updated
- [x] Basic linting and examples unit tests included

Testing notes: examples include small unit tests under redwood-examples/.github/workflows that run a lightweight mock server and smoke test tool calling handlers. Local manual verification performed by author and reviewers. CI initially failed on docs build due to a broken code fence in the quickstart; fixed in a followup commit.

Related: ENG-1982 (agent templates), PM-745 (quickstart prioritization).
